signatures.description: Implement a source map transcoder that decodes base64 VLQ mappings, chains two maps (minified -> transpiled -> original), and resolves originalPositionFor correctly when segments have 1, 4, or 5 fields, duplicate generated columns, and out-of-order segments. Hard part: getting the running-field state machine and nearest-predecessor lookup exactly right across chained maps, matching the ECMA source map spec bit-for-bit on adversarial inputs.
